facebookAccount.notes: time the system automatically retrieves new cookies from email/password, unit is minute, if you set null, the system will not automatically retrieve new cookies.

notesLanguage: change to your language with ISO 639-1 code, available languages: vi (Vietnamese), en (English)
noPrefixNotes: When true, Bot Admins (role 2) and Developers (role 4) can run commands without the prefix (inline with arguments or multiline). Casual conversation containing command words or starting with casual phrases is ignored.

commandReaction.notes: Controls bot reactions on issued commands. 'enable': true/false; 'emoji': reaction emoji (e.g. 👍, ❤️, 🔥, ✨); 'mode': 'media' (react only on image/media commands) or 'all' (react on all commands).

notes_premiumUsers: List of user IDs with premium access (role 3)
notes_devUsers: List of developer IDs with full access (role 4)

whiteListMode.notes: if you enable this feature, only the ids in the whiteListIds list can use the bot

whiteListModeThread.notes: if you enable this feature, only the thread in the whiteListThreadIds list can use the bot

spamProtection.notes: Auto-ban threads when users spam commands.

unsendOnReaction.notes: when a bot admin (role 2) reacts with one of the reactions below on a message sent by the bot, the bot will unsend that message.

reactMirror.notes: when a bot admin (role 2) reacts with any emoji on someone else's message, the bot mirrors the same emoji onto that message.

noPrefix.notes: allow using commands without a prefix for admins. Normal messages are never treated as commands unless first word matches a command name.

commandSuggestion.notes: when a prefixed command is not found, reply with the closest command name.
